home.title: Meeting notes, in your language
home.subtitle: Record in English, Hindi or Tamil. Get a transcript, summary and action items, processed only on your own server.
home.waiting_one: {{count}} meeting is waiting to be processed. It will continue when the server is reachable.
home.waiting_other: {{count}} meetings are waiting to be processed. They will continue when the server is reachable.
home.empty: No meetings yet. Tap Start recording to capture your first one.

consent.title: Before you record
consent.body: Make sure everyone in the meeting knows it is being recorded and agrees to it.
consent.point1: Audio and notes are stored on this device.
consent.point2: Audio is sent only to the server set in Settings (your own server), or processed in this browser.
consent.point3: You can delete the audio or the whole meeting at any time.
consent.remember: Don't show this again on this device

mic.stepsIOS: On iPhone/iPad: open Settings → Safari → Microphone (or Settings → MeetNotes) and choose Allow, then reload.
mic.stepsAndroid: On Android: tap the lock icon next to the address bar → Permissions → Microphone → Allow, then reload.
mic.stepsDesktop: Click the lock or site-settings icon next to the address bar, set Microphone to Allow, then reload the page.

denied.title: Microphone access is blocked
denied.body: MeetNotes needs the microphone to record. Nothing is recorded until you allow it.

notfound.title: No microphone found
notfound.body: Connect a microphone or headset and try again.

busy.title: Microphone is busy
busy.body: Another app (a call or another tab) may be using the microphone. Close it and try again.

insecure.title: Secure connection required
insecure.body: Browsers only allow recording on https:// pages or on localhost. Open MeetNotes over HTTPS.

unsupported.title: Recording not supported
unsupported.body: This browser can't record audio. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

unknown.title: Couldn't start the microphone
unknown.body: Something went wrong while opening the microphone. Please try again.

install.title: Install MeetNotes
install.body: Add it to your home screen or desktop for quick access, even offline.

update.offlineReady: MeetNotes is ready to work offline.

banner.queued: Waiting to transcribe. This continues automatically when the server is reachable.
banner.notesQueued: Waiting to write notes. This continues automatically when the server is reachable.

record.switchedToBrowser: Server unreachable, now transcribing in this browser.
record.listening: Listening… text appears every few seconds.
record.transcriptHint: The transcript appears here while you record.

meeting.title: Meeting title
meeting.notFound: This meeting doesn't exist or was deleted.
meeting.confirmDelete: Delete this meeting, its audio, transcript and notes? This can't be undone.
meeting.confirmDeleteAudio: Delete the audio recording? The transcript and notes are kept, but you won't be able to re-transcribe or label speakers.

notes.confirmRegenerate: Replace the current notes (including your edits) with new ones?
notes.noTranscript: There's no transcript to summarise yet.

transcript.confirmRefine: Transcribe the full recording again? This replaces the current transcript, including edits.

actions.noNotes: Generate notes to extract action items.

export.shareUnsupported: Sharing isn't supported here, so the notes were copied instead.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accessTokenHint: Only if ACCESS_TOKEN is set on your server.
settings.authError: The access token is missing or wrong.
settings.mixedHint: Choose a mixed option for meetings that switch between Tamil/Hindi and English.
settings.sttAuto: My server, or this browser when offline
settings.browserModelHint: Runs Whisper on this device with WebGPU or WebAssembly. Download it once to use it offline.
settings.llmModelHint: Any model pulled into Ollama, e.g. qwen2.5:7b or qwen2.5:3b.
settings.privacyText: Meetings are stored only on this device. Audio and transcripts are sent only to the server above. No third-party services or API keys are used.
settings.showConsent: Show the consent notice before each recording
settings.notPersisted: browser may clear data when storage is low
settings.confirmDeleteAll: Delete ALL meetings, audio and notes on this device? This can't be undone.
